Section.Heading: Interpretation
Section.Text: In this Act, "controller" means the person who determines the purposes of processing.

Section.Heading: Scope
Section.Text: This Act applies to all processing of personal data.

Section.Heading: Penalties
Section.Text: A fine not exceeding 5000 may be imposed.

Section.Heading: Commencement
Section.Text: This Act comes into force on 1 January 2021.
